text:
frank: pulling a slim action list from the PM notes so we can track ownership and avoid repeating the outage pattern. reply with \"take: <item> ETA\" to claim.

frank: short problem summary: maintenance routing hiccup -> missed cross-region snapshot -> ad-hoc partial restore that took too long. recurring exposure: insufficient pre-checks + long dns ttl.

maya: i'll take backup health + snapshot parity. plan: small parity probe after each snapshot and a nightly parity alert. quick win within 3d, automation in 3w.

chen: routing owner here. i'll add a pre-push BGP stability check and an automated fallback that flips a route if convergence > 25s. proto in repo and needs infra review. ETA proto 1w.

oliver: i'll own the restore runbook rewrite. aim to add explicit partial-restore recipes, a KV-warming step, and a one-page playbook for on-call. will PR soon.

riley: observability / alerts: i'll add a replication-mismatch metric, a synthetic nightly restore smoke, and a dashboard panel for restore ETA vs baseline. ETA dashboards 5d.

frank: owners: backups=maya, routing=chen, runbook=oliver, obs=riley. i'll create cards and tag owners.

maya: sample parity command i'll put on the ticket:

```
# quick parity check
aws s3 cp s3://backups/latest/manifest.json - | jq -S . > /tmp/manifest
ssh eu1 \"aws s3 cp s3://backups/latest/manifest.json - | jq -S .\" > /tmp/manifest-eu
diff -u /tmp/manifest /tmp/manifest-eu || echo \"PARITY_MISMATCH\"
```

chen: proto link: https://git/repo/net/failover-softflip. tagging eng-infra for review. note: also proposing a temporary dns-ttl 30s during maintenance windows.

oliver: PR draft: https://git/repo/runbooks/pull/211  added partial-restore decision tree and rollback steps. feedback welcome.

incident-bot: Created INC-2026-999: \"DR sweep: owners + quick wins\" and scheduled a follow-up 2026-04-16T15:00Z.

frank: proposal for rehearsals: control-plane dry-run 2026-04-17, full failover drill 2026-04-24. owners, can you confirm availability?

maya: 04-17 dry-run ok.

chen: 04-24 full drill ok; will run routing fallback test.

oliver: both dates ok; will be on-call for runbook execution.

riley: available both dates; will ensure synthetic runs are green.

frank: final step: please reply with \"take: <item> ETA\" so i can populate the tracker. i'll close thread after cards are created. if anything blocks, bump here or escalate to the DR rota. :thumbsup:
